decisive_items: left breast carcinoma diagnosed eleven years earlier
atypical cells were strongly positive for GATA3
response.rationale: GATA3-positive atypical cells within dermal vessels in a patient with prior breast carcinoma strongly favor cutaneous metastasis of breast carcinoma; CD31 positivity is on endothelial cells, not the tumor cells. Angiosarcoma is less likely because the atypical cells are GATA3-positive, and Stewart-Treves syndrome requires chronic lymphedema, typically of the limb.

rejected.why: No chronic lymphedema is described, and the facial location with GATA3-positive tumor cells favors metastatic breast carcinoma over Stewart-Treves syndrome.
